root_query: Has the US unemployment rate been lower in 2026 than it was in January 2023?
refusal_reason: confidence 0.0 below DB floor 0.3 after adversary penalties
objections: The conclusion cannot be evaluated because the January 2023 baseline was never retrieved: the BLS CPS institutions query returned total=0 and no FRED observation for 2023-01 exists in the evidence. The single FRED pull starts at observation_start=2026-01-01, so the pipeline structurally excluded the comparison month it needed. A one-line fetch of UNRATE for 2023-01-01 (publicly known value ~3.4) would either confirm or refute the claim outright — its absence is the decisive gap, not a neutral 'honest_null'.

The evidence set is contaminated by two irrelevant retrievals (a World Bank indicator search keyed on the literal question text, and a CourtListener opinion search doing the same), which suggests the planner fired keyword queries against the question string rather than targeting the measurement. Any conclusion derived from this pool risks being an artifact of which series happened to be fetched, not of the labor market: the only on-point item (UNRATE) was scoped to 2026 by construction.

Even taking the 2026 UNRATE values at face value, the observed decline from 4.3 to 4.1 across Jan–Jul 2026 has a mundane alternative explanation to any substantive improvement being asked about: the question asks about a '2026 minimum', but the July figure (4.1) is the latest vintage as of the 2026-08-24 realtime window and may be revised; a lower preliminary print later revised upward would make the apparent minimum an artifact of vintaging rather than a true realized minimum below the January 2023 level.

The 2026 series shown covers only Jan–Jul with limit=120 and observation_start pinned to 2026-01-01 — a window chosen after the fact. If the intended comparison were 'any month of 2026 vs January 2023', restricting the fetch to 2026 while never fetching 2023 guarantees the pipeline can only ever produce an asymmetric, unverifiable answer; the retrieval design itself selects against finding refuting or confirming baseline data.
